name: algo-spellbook
description: Пошаговый курс по алгоритмам и структурам данных на JavaScript

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-astro-cache.mjs && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs --base=/algo-spellbook
scripts.build:mobile: node scripts/clean-astro-cache.mjs && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 CAPACITOR=true astro build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs --base=/
scripts.check: node scripts/clean-astro-cache.mjs && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check
